confidence_notes: Three web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and two for Siem Reap prices. The RBA observation of 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18 comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rate pages, not from opening the page myself. Food and drink anchors rest on crowd-sourced cost-of-living indexes (Mylifeelsewhere, Expat Exchange) and older Pub Street and Miss Wong listings. Those sources vary and some are dated. Beer is set at tourist-area restaurant prices, slightly above the index figure. Cocktail and wine reflect Pub Street and Lane bar listings of about $3-7 for cocktails and about $4-5 for wine, which I settled on in relation to the local beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no accommodation searches and no live listings inspected. They are the least certain, because prices swing widely with season (July is low season) and with the mix of guesthouses, hostels and resorts.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Siem Reap's own tourist-oriented price levels, cross-checked against other low-cost Southeast Asian tourist hubs such as Luang Prabang and Hoi An, and against Phnom Penh. USD is widely used in Cambodia.
